stamp_seal.instruction: There is a wooden stamp standing to the right of the middle of the table and a purple mat on the right side of the table. Use the right arm only. Pick up the stamp, move it above the purple mat and press its base down onto the mat. Then release the stamp, leaving it standing on the mat.
